summary: Fixed --multi-tenancy-config and --object-ttl-config on schema objects-create/objects-update sending the raw flag string as the request body instead of parsing it as JSON.
reason: Sibling flags on the same command (--module-config, --sharding-config, --vector-config) all parse their string value as JSON before assigning it to the body map, but multiTenancyConfig and objectTtlConfig assigned the raw string directly. Confirmed live: creating a multi-tenant collection with --multi-tenancy-config '{"enabled":true}' returned HTTP 400 ("cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field Class.multiTenancyConfig") until fixed to parse-and-validate like its siblings.
validated_outcome: Confirmed live: multi-tenant collection creation, tenant create/get/exists, and tenants audit all pass against a real Weaviate Cloud cluster after the fix.
